title: Sentsa Africa
subtitle: Digital platform for African social enterprise
description: A web platform for Sentsa Africa, an organization focused on driving social impact across African communities. The site serves as a digital presence for communicating mission, programs, and impact to stakeholders and partners.
problem: Social enterprises in Africa often lack a polished, professional digital presence that communicates their impact effectively to international partners, donors, and the communities they serve. Generic templates fail to capture the nuance of mission-driven work.
role: Built the complete website including content architecture, responsive design, performance optimization, and deployment. Translated the organization's mission into a clear, compelling digital experience.
approach: Content-first design approach — started with information architecture that prioritizes the organization's key messages, then built a responsive, accessible frontend optimized for both desktop stakeholders and mobile-first community members. Focused on fast load times and clear visual hierarchy.
hardestDecision: Balancing visual richness with performance — impact stories benefit from rich media, but the target audience often accesses the site on constrained networks. Implemented progressive loading and optimized assets to serve both needs.
outcome: Live at sentsafrica.com, serving as the organization's primary digital presence.
whatIdChange: Would add a multilingual content system for broader accessibility, implement a newsletter and impact reporting dashboard for stakeholders, and add structured data for improved search visibility.
